answers.reason: The senate decides on matters of the whole university, and research staff only take part in bodies where their own group's matters are decided.
Budget planning rounds allocate funds, which is not the specific body designated for the research staff group.
An appointment committee selects candidates for professorships, which is outside the specific matters for the research staff group.
A faculty council decides on faculty affairs, whereas research staff only participate in their own specific kind of body.
An examination board decides on examination matters of individual students, not the matters of the research staff group.
